name: IPverse relief turntable
description: Cutout PNG -> Blender silhouette relief, or GLB -> imported mesh: turntable.mp4, poster.png, meta.json (+ model.glb for relief) under OutputPrefix/.

parameterDefinitions.name: InputUri
parameterDefinitions.description: s3://bucket/key of the cutout PNG (relief) or of a GLB (turntable of that mesh)

parameterDefinitions.name: OutputPrefix
parameterDefinitions.description: s3://bucket/prefix for outputs, no trailing slash

embeddedFiles.name: Run
embeddedFiles.data:
"""Deadline task: s3 cutout PNG (relief) or GLB (Hunyuan3D mesh) -> Blender (embedded Relief file) -> turntable.mp4 -> s3 OutputPrefix/."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

import boto3

input_uri, output_prefix, frames, width, height, samples, accent, relief = sys.argv[1:9]


def s3_split(uri):
    if not uri.startswith("s3://"):
        sys.exit("expected s3://bucket/key, got %r" % uri)
    bucket, _, key = uri[5:].partition("/")
    return bucket, key


s3 = boto3.client("s3")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="relief-") as work:
    ext = os.path.splitext(input_uri)[1].lower()
    src, out = os.path.join(work, "input" + ext), os.path.join(work, "out")
    s3.download_file(*s3_split(input_uri), src)
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("PYTHONPATH", "PYTHONHOME")}  # Blender brings its own Python
    subprocess.run(["blender", "-b", "--factory-startup", "-noaudio", "--python-exit-code", "1", "--python", relief, "--",
                    "--glb" if ext == ".glb" else "--image", src, "--out", out, "--frames", frames, "--width", width, "--height", height,
                    "--samples", samples, "--thickness", "0.12", "--accent", accent], check=True, env=env)
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-framerate", "24", "-i", os.path.join(out, "frames", "%04d.png"),
                    "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-movflags", "+faststart",
                    os.path.join(out, "turntable.mp4")], check=True)
    bucket, prefix = s3_split(output_prefix.rstrip("/"))
    for name, content_type in (("turntable.mp4", "video/mp4"), ("model.glb", "model/gltf-binary"),
                               ("poster.png", "image/png"), ("meta.json", "application/json")):
        if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, name)):  # GLB mode exports no model.glb
            continue
        s3.upload_file(os.path.join(out, name), bucket, prefix + "/" + name, ExtraArgs={"ContentType": content_type})
        print("uploaded s3://%s/%s/%s" % (bucket, prefix, name), flush=True)
